fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
A warranty date read straight off the receipt

Buyers of the Kestrel grinder register it with the serial number and a photo of the receipt. The form reads the purchase date off the photo, adds two years, and saves the warranty end date to the buyer's contact in HubSpot. A receipt it cannot read goes to the support queue for a person to check.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { paidEvents: "I run Harbor Food Bank and need a registration form for our spring dinner. We have 180 seats at $85 each. Guests pick a meal and pay through Stripe Checkout, and a seat counts only once payment clears. When the last seat sells, switch the form to a waitlist, and email the first person on it whenever someone cancels.", productWarranties: "Build a product registration form for our Kestrel coffee grinder. Buyers enter the serial number and upload a photo of their receipt. Read the purchase date from the photo, add two years for the warranty end date, and save it to the buyer's contact in HubSpot. Send any receipt you cannot read to our support queue.", marketVendors: "Build vendor registration for the Riverside Saturday market. Each vendor picks a booth and pays the booth fee. Food vendors must upload a county health permit. Hold any food vendor whose permit is missing or ends before market day, and show me the reason. Craft and art vendors go straight to booth assignment.", memberPrograms: "I coordinate Elm Street Garden. We have 40 plots this spring. Gardeners who had a plot last year get the first week to register and keep their bed. After that, newcomers get the remaining plots in sign-up order. Anyone who misses out goes on a waitlist ranked by when they registered." };
